exposure: Hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (chronic hypertension, gestational hypertension, preeclampsia, superimposed preeclampsia)
outcome: Duration of second stage of labor
cohort: 55,572 nulliparous and multiparous women undergoing induction of labor at term without a prior Cesarean section
finding: Women with chronic hypertension and superimposed preeclampsia experienced longer labor durations compared to women without hypertension, while those with gestational hypertension and preeclampsia progressed through labor more rapidly.
